name: chrome-profile-names
description: Show your Chrome profile names (Home, Work) instead of 'Browser 1' and device IDs when Claude in Chrome asks which browser to use.

hideRemote.description: Hide browsers that aren't paired in any Chrome profile on this machine, since they're on another computer. The list and the picker always keep at least one browser, so a profile the mod can't read never disappears on its own.
hideRemote.title: Hide browsers on other machines
